item.title: Author Post :)
item.content:encoded:
Comic
i drew dis awhile ago i think

Haha hello! I haven't actually posted in awhile since my art page thingy, and i was on the fence about this little guy called davy bones for awhile! I ADORE WWS it is so cute and i love it and it is totally my writing style. So I was like let's do it! And this is my first GOI format EVER! So yea haha I hope you enjoy! Thank you to barredowl, Cyvstvi, Dr Fullham and BlueJones for reading beforehand! <3
Spoilers
:D

okay so i was kinda scared that the hints of davy bones being a little cheeky and a little evil were like, too subtle but I hope they're not! So basically the algae is infectious, I guess? and Davy Bones (the algae) is trying to get their submarine open, making the researchers touch him etc. so it can spread. I think it's a cool idea. Also I love the bone kingdom. all praise bone kingdom.

-
